summary: Audited all 71 telencephalon structure records (telencephalon-cortex 10, -cortical-areas 12, -somatotopy 16, -basal-ganglia 10, -limbic 6, -hippocampal-subfields 4, -white-matter 8, -optic-pathway 3, -cranial-nerves 2) field by field against the committed meshes, taxonomy.json, levels.json and the records' own cross-references. Wrote docs/audit/v15/telencephalon.findings.json (20 findings, each with the 12 required keys and verdict/severity enums) and docs/audit/v15/telencephalon.md. Counts: wrong 7 (4 major, 3 minor), suspect 11 (1 major, 10 minor), unverifiable-here 2 (minor), 0 critical; 11 further 'verifiedClaims' entries record what was checked and found sound. Position was measured, not eyeballed: every origin3d was projected onto ctx-hemisphere-l (40,388 verts, nearest-vertex + vertex-normal sign) and the deep structures were tested inside/outside against their own committed casts by ray parity and coronal bounding boxes. Top findings: (1) ctx-m1 origin3d is 23.7 au from its own ctx-m1-* somatotopy strip and ctx-s1 13.5 au from its ctx-s1-* strip, though both are the taxonomy PARENTS of those measured segments (wrong, major); (2) ctx-sma is 34.5 au = 41 mm from the medial foot representation its own function text says it abuts (wrong, major); (3) tract-optic-nerve lists lvl-tel-thalamostriate (y=48) while its own waypoints stop at y=23.5 (wrong, major); (4) tract-optic-radiation lists levels 18 and 48 au beyond its own waypoints (suspect, major, = the architect's D2 re-measured); (5) the eight ctx-s1-* anchors call the S1 strip 'precentral gyrus' (systematic copy-paste nomenclature defect); (6) ctx-v2 sits 5.56 au INSIDE the ribbon and surf-planum-temporale 2.41 au outside it; (7) nuc-dentate-gyrus's contextNote quotes x~21.5 against its own committed x=16. Every marked basisKind is internal-contradiction (12), committed-mesh (5), own-knowledge (2) or external (1, web-cited optic-nerve axon-count figure). No data, script, gate or component file was modified: git diff over the nine audited files and levels.json is empty, the only files added are the two deliverables, and the probe scripts live in gitignored .dsh-scratch/tel/. Verified: findings file parses and prints 'findings 20' (evidence command exits 0), the self-consistency checker .dsh-scratch/tel/check-findings.mjs re-derives the by-verdict/by-severity tables and they match the .md exactly, and 'npm run validate' still prints 0 errors / 0 warning(s).
